title: Marcianus graecus Z. 299 (=584): Corpus of the Greek Alchemists
shelf_note: A 10th–11th-century Greek minuscule codex of the alchemical corpus. This leaf is from Olympiodorus' commentary on Zosimos, which fits the title. No tradition or collection is set to test it against.
structure_note: pages_translated is 0 in the structure counts but 397 in the book field, so one of the two counters is wrong. 199 of 432 records carry a printed number, which fits recto-only pencil foliation (record 360 = fol. 169). The 10 backsteps and 10 repeats are more likely misread pencil folio numerals, or verso records that picked up the recto's number, than a scan splice. That is not verifiable from one page.

pages.layout: single column of Greek minuscule in brown ink, wide blank outer margin; modern pencil foliation '169' top and bottom right; edge of the facing leaf's text visible at left (correctly ignored by the OCR)

book_verdict: Right leaf, but the OCR misreads most of the Zosimos quotation in the top half. It loses 'know yourself, then you will know God', reverses 'spitting on matter' into 'loving what is yours', and drops Chemes and Parmenides. The English renders these misreads fluently, and notes paper over them.
